purpose: The TASK-024 approval UI end to end against the real API and MySQL: U3 enables PO approval (wrong password rejected, reason kept), U1 creates and submits two POs and withdraws and resubmits one, U2 checks the decision form focus order, gets 403 on a wrong password, approves through a response lost after the server committed, stays locked while uncertain, replays the same eventId to the committed decision (Idempotency-Replayed header, identical body), then rejects the second PO; no uncaught page or console errors
data: Per run with a unique suffix, inserted into the already-migrated erp_dev: 4 users via server/scripts/createUser.js (1 disabled bootstrap), 3 roles, 1 supplier, 1 item, 1 UOM, 1 SKU, 1 SKU-UOM, 3 device approvals via server/scripts/approveDevice.js; the run creates 2 purchase orders of 1 line each. Sets purchasing_settings row 1 require_po_approval=0 before the run
concurrency: 1 worker, 1 browser context at a time (3 sequential contexts), no parallel requests
thresholds: The junit report has exactly 1 testcase and no failure, error or skipped element; no timing threshold
trigger: Proposed: server-tests shard 1, in the existing real-MySQL browser step after coverage and the shard identity record: every admitted PR dispatch, every push to main and the existing weekly schedule
cost: Measured locally on an already-migrated database, excluding migrate: 12.8-14.3 s over 3 runs at 9c1680fb. Not measured in CI. No new job, no new service, no capacity workload

cases: PO approval: settings, submit, withdraw/resubmit, approve through a lost response, reject
